subject.title: feat: clarify publisher discovery state labels

question: Should ClawHub accept this PR's Official/Public profile/Public catalog vocabulary and profile-discovery spec now, or wait for the adjacent account/feed stack to settle?
rationale: The diff is source-backed, but it creates durable product vocabulary for trust and discovery labels; automation cannot decide whether that vocabulary should land before adjacent feed/state work.

options.title: Accept After Proof
options.body: Require a real browser screenshot or recording, then land this narrow vocabulary slice if maintainers are comfortable with it standing as durable intent.

options.title: Defer Until Feed Stack Settles
options.body: Keep this draft paused until the account feed and publisher feed work define the final public vocabulary together.

options.title: Accept As A Narrow Slice Now
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally accept the current labels as publisher-profile-only wording and leave broader feed labels to later PRs.

recommendation.title: Accept After Proof
recommendation.body: Require a real browser screenshot or recording, then land this narrow vocabulary slice if maintainers are comfortable with it standing as durable intent.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick-Erichsen is tied by blame and PR metadata to the existing official-publisher spec and current Official/Verified UI behavior.
